scope: 8 independent held-pose views (19 m and 25 m, 4 headings), not full driving dataset semantic certification

2016_Hyundai_Universe.notes: Reviewed all four headings at both independent distances. Body, wheels and roof align with the LiDAR-only default-scale 3D envelope (11.97 x 2.89 x 3.33 m); MORAI raw box sits above the roof (3.53 m). Image refinement was rejected: its change mask included the cast shadow and pushed the right face out by the 0.5 m cap (kept as refined_rejected_shadow.json). Calibration from the 18/24 m capture only: the 12 m capture was refused by MORAI spawn (NOT_CREATE_OBJECT).
